meta.tagline: Your private driver, whenever you need.

footer.tagline: Private chauffeur by subscription — discretion, punctuality and comfort.

home.stepsLead: Three simple steps to have your driver always available.
home.step1Body: Select the monthly minute package that best fits your routine.
home.step2Body: Schedule pickups in advance — airport, meetings, events or daily errands.
home.step3Body: Your dedicated driver handles the rest. No surprises, no surge pricing.
home.advantagesLead: A private chauffeur service designed for those who value time and comfort.
home.advantage1: Dedicated private driver — not a random ride marketplace.
home.advantage2: Fixed monthly price — no dynamic fares or billing surprises.
home.advantage3: Advance booking aligned with your schedule.
home.advantage4: Premium vehicle, discretion and punctuality on every trip.
home.advantage5: Direct phone and WhatsApp support when you need it.
home.plansLead: Included minutes every month. Choose the pace that makes sense for you.
home.plansNote: Unused minutes do not roll over to the next month.
home.rule1: Plan minutes are valid during the subscription month and do not automatically carry over.
home.rule2: We do not use dynamic pricing — the monthly fee is always as stated.
home.rule3: Tolls, parking and airport fees are not included in the minutes.
home.rule4: Service depends on advance booking and confirmed availability.
home.contactLead: We are available to answer questions or help you choose a plan.

plans.title: Plans
plans.lead: Choose your monthly minute plan. Auto-renewal, cancel anytime.
plans.rule1: Included minutes are valid in the current month and do not roll over.
plans.rule2: No dynamic pricing — the monthly fee is fixed per plan.
plans.rule3: Each trip consumes minutes based on actual duration (minimum charge applies).
plans.rule4: Tolls, parking and airport entries are charged separately.
plans.rule5: Email confirmation and a complete profile are required before your first trip.
plans.loginRequired: Please log in to subscribe to a plan.
